text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Implementing the periodic consolidation technique from the arXiv paper (\"Consolidation reduces cross-fact interference\") as a preprocessing step before the rewrite operation will improve the rewrite‑vs‑append ablation performance required by Reviewer 2, by decreasing cross‑fact interference and thus yielding higher downstream recall scores.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["13b3b6fa","52bebe86"],"tags":["ablation","consolidation","rewrite","memory"]},{"statement":"Utilizing the newly approved 2400 H100 GPU‑hours quota to train two parallel versions of the memory‑augmented model – one employing MemGPT’s virtual context paging with rewrite operations and the other using a naive append strategy – will provide sufficient compute resources to generate statistically significant results for the ICLR rebuttal study.","confidence":0.71,"support_ids":["559abff0","52bebe86","f1fbdbac"],"tags":["GPU-allocation","MemGPT","rewrite","append","experiment"]}]}
